features: 35W Fast Charging Powerbank: The Portronics Titan 35 delivers up to 35W Type-C PD fast charging, making it ideal for quickly charging smartphones, tablets, earbuds, and other compatible devices anytime, anywhere.

20000mAh High-Capacity Battery: Equipped with a powerful 20000mAh battery capacity that provides multiple charges for your devices, perfect for travel, office, daily commutes, and emergency backup usage.

Built-in Charging Cables: Comes with integrated Type-C and 8-Pin cables, allowing you to charge Android and iOS devices without carrying extra cables, making charging more convenient and clutter-free.
PPS Charging Technology: Supports advanced PPS fast charging technology for optimized power delivery, improved charging efficiency, and safer charging performance for compatible devices.
LED Digital Battery Display: Features a bright LED digital display that shows the exact remaining battery percentage, helping you track power levels accurately and recharge on time.

Multiple Input & Output Options: Includes Type-C input/output support and USB-A output, enabling convenient charging for multiple devices with wide compatibility across smartphones, gadgets, and accessories.
Portable & Travel-Friendly Design: Compact, lightweight, and easy to carry with an integrated cable design that also acts as a hanging strap, making it ideal for travel, work, and everyday carry.
description: Portronics Titan 35 is a powerful and portable 20000mAh fast charging powerbank designed to keep your devices powered throughout the day. With up to 35W Type-C PD output, it delivers fast and efficient charging for smartphones, tablets, wireless earbuds, and other compatible gadgets. The built-in Type-C and 8-Pin charging cables eliminate the hassle of carrying separate cables, offering maximum convenience for both Android and iOS users. Equipped with advanced PPS charging technology, Titan 35 intelligently adjusts power delivery for faster, safer, and more optimized charging performance. The LED digital display accurately shows the remaining battery percentage, so you always know when it’s time to recharge. It also features multiple connectivity options including USB-A output and Type-C input/output for enhanced compatibility. Its sleek, compact, and travel-friendly design makes it easy to carry in bags, backpacks, or pockets, while the integrated cable loop adds portability and convenience. Whether you are travelling, working, gaming, attending meetings, or commuting daily, the Portronics Titan 35 ensures reliable backup power whenever you need it.
